# Manual Planimeter Entry

This functionality is only available for gas meters.

Use the Planimeter Entry screen to calculate the process variable for differential pressure, static pressure, and temperature for a specific meter for a specified date. You can provide manual values for the process variables, or, if the transducer ranges are set within the meter’s characteristics, you can provide a planimeter read. The process variable will then be calculated based on the planimeter read and ranges.

Before entering planimeter data, transducer low and high ranges for differential pressure, static pressure, and temperature must be set in the Volume Editor (**Characteristics** \> **Ranges** tab).

<div class="procedure">

To manually enter planimeter data:

1.  Go to **Import** \> **Manual Entry** \> **Planimeter**.
2.  Enter the planimeter reads to calculate the process variables ((read\*read)/100\*(high-low)+low); otherwise, enter the manual values to populate the process variables. When all three process variables are populated, the Import button will be enabled.
3.  Click **Import** to import the process variables to the meter flow data or analysis.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 512;height: 245;" />

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Planimeter Entry Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Plaimeter Entry screen:

#### Ranges

- If the transducer low and high ranges for differential pressure, static pressure, and temperature have not been set up in Meter Characteristics, the ranges will display as "0 – X" in red.
- If the transducer low ranges for differential pressure, static pressure, and temperature have not been set up in Meter Characteristics, but the high range has, the ranges will display as "0 – configured high range" in red.
- If the low and high ranges for differential pressure, static pressure, and temperature have both been set up in Meter Characteristics, the ranges will display the associated ranges in black.

#### Planimeter Read

- If the transducer low and high ranges for differential pressure, static pressure, and temperature have not been set up in Meter Characteristics, the Planimeter Read edit boxes are disabled.
- If the Manual Value edit boxes have been entered, the Planimeter Read edit boxes are disabled.
- Planimeter read values must be numbers between 0 and 10.

#### Manual Value

- The Manual Value edit boxes are enabled only if corresponding Planimeter Read edit boxes are empty.

</div>
